newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIORENTINA FINED AND BANNED FROM PLAYING AT HOME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA FINED AND BANNED FROM PLAYING AT HOME.

text.p: Fiorentina were ordered to play their next two European matches 500 kms from Florence and were also fined 75,000 Swiss francs ($51,000) by UEFA on Tuesday.

UEFA, European soccer's governing body, pounished the Italian club following disturbances when they played Barcelona in the second leg of their European Cup Winners Cup semifinal second leg last Wednesday.

Barcelona coach Bobby Robson was hit by a bottle while players Sergei Barjuan and Ivan de la Pena were hit by other objects thrown by Fiorentina fans as Barcelona beat Fiorentina 2-0 at the Artemio Franchi Stadium to clinch a place in the Cup Winners Cup Final on a 3-1 aggregate.

UEFA's Control and Disciplinary Committee who made the decisions, also suspended Fiorentina's Portuguese captain Rui Costa for four European matches and his Swedish team mate Stefan Schwarz for three matches for insulting the referee after the game.
Fiorentina's Luis Oliveira, who was sent off, was suspended for two matches as was Barcelona's Miguel Nadal who was also shown the red card.

The committee also fined AEK Athens 40,000 Swiss francs because of what they deemed bad organisation and behaviour of the Greek fans at the European Cup Winners Cyup quarterfinal against Paris Saint Germain in Athens in March.
